entities.name: Abd Allah ibn Abbas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbbās, also known as Ibn ʿAbbās, was one of the cousins of the prophet Muhammad. He is considered to be the greatest mufassir (exegete) of the Qur'an.
